intro_zh: 如果时代更替不只是换一套文明，而是让旧世界经历一次真正的分裂与统一，会发生什么？「分合」在做这样的实验：从当前世界出发，模拟版图演变，选择一个历史切片，再挑一个新国家继续玩。它目前是需要本地辅助工具的实验原型，不是即订即用的普通 Mod。
intro_en: What if an age change followed a period of political division and unification, rather than simply swapping civilizations? Fenhe explores that idea: simulate changes from the existing world, choose a snapshot, then continue as a new power. It is currently an experimental prototype requiring a local helper, not a plug-and-play Workshop mod.
limits_zh: 当前 0.2.0-alpha 由游戏模块和界面模块共同组成，还需要本地辅助工具与调试配置。已有 Windows 和 Mac 1.5.0 特定场景的生成、进入新局及读档记录；不是所有地图和时代通用验证。它不是原生时代过渡的完整替代，也不会无损保留人口、巨作、历史、科技和全部军队。
limits_en: The 0.2.0-alpha prototype combines game and UI modules and requires local helper/debug setup. Specific Windows and Mac 1.5.0 scenarios have records of generation, entry and save loading, not universal map or age coverage. It is not a complete native age-transition replacement and does not preserve population, great works, history, technology or entire armies losslessly.

sections.zh: 让当前世界走向另一种版图
sections.pain_zh: 一张熟悉的地图往往对应熟悉的势力边界，想看它经历另一段历史，就得从头想象。
sections.fix_zh: 分合从当前世界的定居点和势力出发，模拟分裂与统一。城市位置成为新世界的基础，而政治归属可以重新组合，让“接下来谁统治这里”变成可探索的问题。
sections.pain_en: A familiar map usually comes with familiar borders. Imagining a different political history often means starting from scratch.
sections.fix_en: Fenhe uses the current world’s settlements and powers as the starting point for division and unification. City locations provide continuity while political ownership can change.
sections.shot: 实机生成后的新版图，主要势力边界清晰，附原始样本存档与模拟记录；不要用概念地图作效果证据。

sections.zh: 选择分裂或统一的历史切片
sections.en: Choose the moment you want to play
sections.pain_zh: 模拟出很多轮变化，最有意思的未必是最后一轮：也许是群雄并起，也许是大国刚刚成形。
sections.fix_zh: 可以从模拟结果里选择更分裂或更统一的阶段，把这个切片作为后续场景的基础。不是每次都强制走向同一个结局。
sections.pain_en: The most interesting simulated state may not be the last one: perhaps many rivals have emerged, or a few large powers are taking shape.
sections.fix_en: Choose a more fragmented or unified snapshot from the simulation as the basis of the next scenario, rather than always accepting a single final outcome.
sections.shot: 原型选择切片界面，选定轮次与势力数量可读；再核对生成场景与该切片一致。

sections.zh: 换一个国家，在新局势里继续
sections.en: Continue as a power in the new world
sections.pain_zh: 只看模拟结果像在看地图动画，真正有意思的是亲自接手其中一个国家。
sections.fix_zh: 选定一个人类玩家势力后，原型把相应的城市归属、主要国家和城邦关系带入新的时代场景，再进行存档与读档核验。已有样本跑通过这个流程，但仍是有限场景下的实验结果。
sections.pain_en: Watching the result is one thing; taking control of one of those powers is the more interesting possibility.
sections.fix_en: Choose one human-controlled power and build the new-age scenario with the corresponding city ownership, major powers and city-states. Selected samples have completed entry and save/reload checks, but remain limited prototype results.
sections.shot: 新场景载入后玩家领袖、所属城市和时代信息，使用已通过的样本；不声称继承全部旧世界状态。

approval: 既有手柄文章已授权发布；本次其他新稿等待用户验收，不发布。
